title: Affine and linear subspace probabilities
statement: Let $H$ be a linear subspace of $\mathbb F_2^n$ and let $a\in\mathbb F_2^n$. The probability that a uniformly chosen vector belongs to $a+H$ equals the probability that it belongs to $H$.
hypotheses_covered: $H$ is a linear subspace of $\mathbb F_2^n$
